source.authority: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
source.text: The controller shall provide the data subject with: (a) the identity and contact details of the controller; (c) the purposes and legal basis; (e) the recipients or categories of recipients; and further: (2)(a) the period for which personal data will be stored; (2)(b) the existence of the right to request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and to object.

assertion: controllerIdentityDisclosed == true && purposesDisclosed == true && recipientsDisclosed == true && retentionPeriodDisclosed == true && rightsInformed == true
